groups.operation: Process XInclude on the parsed document and allocate its document URL base.
groups.condition: Allocation of the document URL base fails.
groups.capability: Record XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY in the XInclude context so xmlXIncludeGetLastError can report it.
groups.consequence: The existing allocation-failure assertion may fail if ctxt->errNo does not contain XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY.
groups.equivalence_reason: All three describe the same allocation failure, context error code, and harness check. They differ only in which reachability uncertainty they emphasize.

groups.operation: Deliver an XInclude error through a handler registered on the XInclude context.
groups.condition: A context-specific structured handler is registered and an XInclude error occurs.
groups.capability: Store the handler and user data, then pass them through xmlXIncludeErr to __xmlRaiseError.
groups.consequence: The registered handler may not receive the XInclude error and its user data.
groups.equivalence_reason: All three address the same context-handler registration and error-delivery capability.

groups.operation: Process a local XPointer inclusion in XInclude streaming mode.
groups.condition: Streaming mode is enabled and the inclusion uses a local XPointer expression.
groups.consequence: The streaming-mode restriction may not be exercised or enforced.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same streaming-mode restriction and the same unresolved reader route.

groups.operation: Pass the parsed document node to xmlXIncludeProcessNode.
groups.condition: The old harness supplies the document node, whose doc field has an unknown value.
groups.capability: Pass the node->doc guard and reach DOM XInclude processing.
groups.consequence: If the guard rejects the node, the DOM XInclude operation does not run.
groups.equivalence_reason: This concerns entry into processing through the document-node guard, distinct from error reporting after an allocation failure.
